specs.name: Potion Prowess
specs.desc: Leverage the diametric power of Light and Void to brew even more exhilirating potions.

specs.name: Fluent in Flasks
specs.desc: Refine your techniques to make the most of flasks and phials.

specs.name: Alchemical Mastery
specs.desc: Focus your efforts on making the most of your reagents.

specs.name: Transmutation Authority
specs.desc: Turn one reagent into another!

specs.name: Craftsmithing
specs.desc: Improve your ability to support your fellow crafters with high quality tools, accessories, and tool stones.

specs.name: The Old Ways
specs.desc: Gain Multicraft, Resourcefulness, Ingenuity, and additional Skill when crafting alloys.

specs.name: Armorsmithing
specs.desc: Improve your ability to craft plate armor and shields.

specs.name: Weaponsmithing
specs.desc: Improve your ability to craft weapons.

specs.name: Elevating Equipment
specs.desc: Empower your ability to magically enhance equipment, improving your talents at creating permanent equipment enchantments.

specs.name: Transitories, Tonics, and Tools
specs.desc: Perfect the art of temporary illusions, equipment, and mana oils.

specs.name: Disenchanting Delegate
specs.desc: Master your disenchanting capabilities, maximizing the quality of reagents you receive when destroying items.

children.name: Crystal Collector
children.desc: Improve your understanding of complex Disenchanting rituals, improving the quality of materials you receive when breaking down Epic items.

specs.name: Spellbound Shatterer
specs.desc: Specialize in shattering the magical essences of Midnight, gleaning fleeting but increasingly potent crafting bonuses from the magic within. Your studies will also benefit your Concentration!

specs.name: Market Mobility
specs.desc: Master the different tools and accessories used by various professions.

specs.name: Combat Analytics
specs.desc: Master an Engineer's adaptable augmentations.

specs.name: Recycling
specs.desc: Master the art of recycling crafted reagents from other Midnight Professions into useful parts for Midnight Engineering!

specs.name: Bits and Bots
specs.desc: Whether you need a pick-me-up, or to put your enemies down, Bits and Bots is here to help. Create and improve upon interesting gadgets, gizmos, and all the bits in between through the power of science!

specs.name: Bountiful Harvests
specs.desc: Practice the meticulous process of spotting, harvesting, and storing your herbs more efficiently, gaining expertise focused on the various herbs found in the Midnight region.

specs.name: Botany
specs.desc: Study the plantlife in the Midnight region, learning how to efficiently gather and grow them.

specs.name: Midnight Overload
specs.desc: Your adventures have brought you to lands both familiar and new. The familiar has changed, and the new brings mysteries to explore. How have the lands affected some of the herbs here, and how can you better gather them?

specs.name: Blueprints
specs.desc: Improve the fundamentals of crafts requiring meticulous, sizeable detail.

specs.name: Calm Hands
specs.desc: Master the fundamentals of Inscription, improving your ability to craft in general.

specs.name: Perfected Products
specs.desc: Master Inscription's fundamental reagents.

specs.name: Darkmoon Curiosity
specs.desc: Master the esoteric Darkmoon Cards, molding them into your creation.

specs.name: Thoughtful Throughput
specs.desc: Focus on your Jewelcrafting fundamentals to become a market powerhouse through greater efficiency.

specs.name: Glamorous Gems
specs.desc: Practice your gemcutting techniques, creating the most dazzling and glamorous gems available.

specs.name: Alluring Accessories
specs.desc: Learn to create the most potent of accessories to compliment the wardrobe of any adventurer or crafter.

specs.name: Proficient Processor
specs.desc: Specialize in the generation of materials and gems, providing the reagents that you and other crafters need.

children.name: Thorium Thresher
children.desc: Learn the telltale signs of gems hiding within Dazzling Thorium, enhancing your ability to locate Eversong Diamonds while prospecting it.

children.name: Silver Scrapper
children.desc: Prepare yourself to shine while working with Brilliant Silver, bestowing the ability to find Eversong Diamonds while prospecting it.

children.name: Tin-vestigator
children.desc: Refuse to sleep on the importance of understanding Umbral Tin, granting you the skill to sometimes spot Eversong Diamonds while prospecting it.

children.name: Copper Consumer
children.desc: Understand the patterns and intricacies of Refulgent Copper, learning how to spot Eversong Diamonds hiding within while prospecting it.

specs.name: Learned Leatherworker
specs.desc: Master your Leatherworking fundamentals to increase your reagent efficiency, ability to concentrate, general stitchwork, and production process.

specs.name: Lasting Leather
specs.desc: Specialize in crafting leather armor, increasing your ability to craft at a higher quality. In addition, learn new patterns and ways to customize the armor you craft!

specs.name: Safeguarding Scales
specs.desc: Specialize in crafting mail armor, increasing your ability to craft at a higher quality. In addition, learn new patterns and ways to customize the armor you craft!

specs.name: Flawless Fortes
specs.desc: Focus on creating more specialized crafts ranging from Professions Equipment to Reagents and Consumables! Increase the quality of these crafts to support adventurer's and fellow crafters alike.

specs.name: Plentiful Ores
specs.desc: Build your knowledge in all of the Midnight ores, learning how to make the most of each deposit.

specs.name: Meticulous Mining
specs.desc: Greatly improve at recovering ore from rich deposits and seams.

specs.name: Over-LODED
specs.desc: Master the art of mining in unexpected circumstances.

specs.name: Thorough Tanning
specs.desc: Improve at your general skinning techniques, learning how to gather, prepare, and store the various standard reagents you can gather from the creatures of Midnight.

specs.name: Gainful Gathering
specs.desc: Specialize in gathering unique materials beyond standard leather and scale.

specs.name: Talented Tracker
specs.desc: Specialize in creating special lures that will draw out Renowned Beasts that are more valuable than standard creatures.

specs.name: Sin'dorei Finery
specs.desc: Specialize in the techniques necessary to outfit adventurers in Silvermoon's latest fashion trends.

specs.name: Nimble Needlework
specs.desc: Empower your techniques that work with Sunfire and Arcanoweave to create wondrous garments and materials.

specs.name: Fabric Specialist
specs.desc: Attune yourself to the cloth used in the various Midnight societies, improving your ability to find cloth and increase the quality.

specs.name: Fiber Arts
specs.desc: Learn how to utilize your resources as efficiently as possible.
